notes: Rare stem: requested "Piel" is unattested for this geminate root (ר-שׁ-שׁ); the corpus attests Poel instead (יְרֹשֵׁשׁ, Jer.5.17), the expected active-intensive stem for geminate roots in place of Piel -- used here in Piel's place per requirement 4 (capture rare stems, e.g. Poel/Polel for geminates).

Strong's own usage list for this root is "impoverish" (Jer.5.17 "impoverish thy fenced cities"; Mal.1.4 "We are impoverished"), which doesn't match the requested glosses as directly. BDB glosses the root itself "beat down, shatter" (Poel) and cites Mal.1.4 verbatim as "we are beaten down" (Pual) -- both match the requested "destroy"/"be beaten down" precisely and are used here instead of Strong's.
